 GOOD FOOD. GOOD FRIENDS. GOOD TIMES.

 
 
 

 
 
 
	

 
 

 
 Homedhonsvick2026-03-02T17:23:41+00:00 
 Welcome to GTs On The Bay
GTs On The Bay sits overlooking Wolf Bay on Canal Road in the heart of Orange Beach. With stunning views and bay front dining, GTs features a diverse and one-of-kind menu. Guests can savor unique culinary choices and a blend of local favorites, in addition to special creations with a family friendly atmosphere. Enjoy a stone hearth pizza oven and fresh made salad bar as well as craft beers and daily happy hour. Soon to be favorites such as our Cajun empanadas, chicken carbonara and fish tacos will delight locals and visitors alike.
Experience Bayview Dining

Let’s do Lunch!
There’s no better way to break up the workday than spending your lunch break with us! Try our Good Time Lunch Special and enjoy the waterfront dining experience you deserve. Choose from Fried Fish with French Fries and Slaw, Shrimp Creole over Jasmine Rice, or our Fried Chicken Breast with Meunière Sauce. Join us today between 11 a.m. and 4 p.m. to refuel and recharge—your table is waiting!

Don’t Skip the Salad Bar

Made fresh daily, our salad bar features crisp romaine lettuce, spring mix, and iceberg lettuce, along with options such as our house-made chicken and pasta salad. With endless toppings and dressings, create your perfect salad. Add a small, large, or endless salad trip to your meal, or choose our soup and salad combo from the $11 Good Times Lunch menu. Don’t miss out—make your plate today!

Stay for Dinner
Why not make tonight special? Our extensive dinner menu has something for everyone. Start with Cajun Empanadas or Firecracker Shrimp, then choose a specialty like Shrimp-n-Grits, Pepper-Seared Tuna, or our GTs Grouper. You won’t want to leave without tasting one of our delightful desserts, sure to satisfy your sweet tooth. Experience a memorable evening with us!

Happy Hour
We have the best on the Island! Our Happy Hour is served daily from 3 p.m. to 5 p.m. and features specials on draft beer, house wines, and awesome appetizers such as our Firecracker Shrimp, Gingered Calamari, or our GTs Dip. What are you waiting for?

Adults and kids of all ages will enjoy the large fish pond in the center dining room. Whether it’s hanging out at the bayside bar or enjoying one the many seafood selections, GTs is definitely a must see and offers nothing short of good times.

 MEET THE TEAM

 
 
 

 
 
 
	

 
 

 
 Aboutdhonsvick2025-09-19T18:14:36+00:00 
 
Unique Culinary Flair
In keeping with their tradition, Brian and Jodi Harsany have once again brought their unique culinary flair to Orange Beach. GTs On The Bay is a diverse and one-of-kind blend of local dishes and soon-to-be favorites. Definitely an unforgettable dining experience focusing on friends, family and food.

Chef Brian Navarro
Brian, an accomplished Executive Chef, traces his culinary roots back to the vibrant culinary landscape of New Orleans. Immersed in the bustling atmosphere of a family-run restaurant from a young age, he honed his skills and developed an unwavering passion for the culinary arts.
With an insatiable curiosity and a bold spirit, Brian fearlessly explores the intricacies of various cuisines, infusing each dish with his signature flair. His dedication to the craft shines through in every creation, as he consistently delivers remarkable flavors and visually stunning presentations that delight our clientele.

Chef Bryan Jensen
Chef Bryan Jensen, Sous Chef, is known for creating unforgettable dining experiences through the artful fusion of flavors, textures, and cultural influences. Born and raised in Orange Beach, AL, Chef Jensen developed an early fascination with food inspired by the rich culinary heritage of his upbringing. He has been with our restaurant family since 2011, working at our sister restaurant, Cobalt the Restaurant. Chef Bryan joined us here at GTs on the Bay in 2022. He loves experimenting with Asian cuisine and cultivating these elements into the dishes here at GTs.
